title: Grateful Dead Live at The Strand Lyceum on 1972-05-24
lineage: AUD: mono crappy Pye cassette recorder with hand-held mike > Ampex R2R > CD-R > EAC > CEP > CDWAV > .shn & CD-R

ai_review.summary: A monster Other One and solid set shine through a generally sub‑par, sometimes scratchy audience recording.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised – especially the towering rendition of The Other One and tight Truckin' > Drums sequence – but listeners are hampered by a low‑fidelity source that suffers from scratchy noise, occasional mic‑stand bumps and a cut‑off SMBH. While the music itself earns high marks, the audio quality ranges from fair to poor.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently rated very high (many comments about a great performance and standout jams), while recording quality is repeatedly described as lacking, yielding an overall weighted score around 4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners report scratchy high‑frequency noise, a mic‑stand bump that sounds like seat‑level recording, and the SMBH segment cut out. Overall clarity is limited compared to other 1972 soundboard tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical late‑’72 tour flow with a strong second set; transitions are smooth and the show maintains high energy throughout.
